n16af8d898d.headline: Government plans to intervene in Repsol, Moeve and BP prices if necessary in light of impact of Persian Gulf conflict
n16af8d898d.summary: Economy Minister Carlos Cuerpo said the government will monitor fuel prices and intervene if necessary, given the impact of the Persian Gulf conflict. He spoke in an interview with TVE.
n16af8d898d.why: Repsol is a major Spanish integrated energy company, and fuel pricing policy affects its retail margins and consumer costs.

impacts.name: Repsol
impacts.why: Government monitoring and possible intervention in fuel prices could affect Repsol's retail fuel pricing.

n6be49444a6.headline: Iran expands strikes, hits near Azerbaijan border as conflict grows
n6be49444a6.summary: Iran struck near the Azerbaijan border as the conflict widened. Azerbaijan demanded an apology and placed its military on full alert.
n6be49444a6.why: Azerbaijan is a Caspian energy exporter and a transit route for Caucasus pipelines, so regional fighting affects energy logistics.

nc61ad2d0cb.headline: Wavering households ease urgency for more rate hikes
nc61ad2d0cb.summary: Economic data released this week will leave the Reserve Bank of Australia a little less concerned about underlying inflation momentum, reducing urgency for further rate hikes.
nc61ad2d0cb.why: The Reserve Bank of Australia sets the cash rate, which drives Australian bond yields, the Australian dollar and borrowing costs for households and businesses.

n13c8034834.headline: Amper 2025 results: margin improvement (3 p.p.) despite lower offshore wind revenues; M&A forecast in 2026
n13c8034834.summary: Amper posted 2025 revenues of €281.7 million, below estimates of €369 million, with the decline mainly due to lower offshore wind revenues and a sale. The company forecasts M&A in 2026.
n13c8034834.why: Amper is a Spanish industrial technology group, and its results show exposure to offshore wind and portfolio disposals.

n70460ddc99.headline: Dozens of Asia-Flagged Oil Tankers Stranded near Strait of Hormuz
n70460ddc99.summary: Dozens of Indian and South Korean oil tankers are stranded near the Strait of Hormuz, halting crude shipments. The situation raises energy security concerns for both countries.
n70460ddc99.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of global seaborne oil, so disruptions there quickly affect crude supply and freight costs.

n06a13013f0.headline: NALCO stock rallies nearly 8% amid aluminium supply fears from US-Iran conflict | Indiablooms - First Portal on Digital News Management
n06a13013f0.summary: NALCO shares jumped nearly 8% as global aluminium prices surged to their highest level since 2022, amid aluminium supply fears tied to the US-Iran conflict.
n06a13013f0.why: National Aluminium Company is an Indian aluminium producer, so its shares track global aluminium prices and energy costs.
n06a13013f0.why_moved: Global aluminium prices surged to their highest since 2022 on supply fears linked to the US-Iran conflict.

nce429fb4a0.headline: 'Galling': Aussies set to pass up another gas windfall
nce429fb4a0.summary: War in the Middle East could drive energy prices towards record highs, but a failure to fix gas supply arrangements means Australia is set to miss out on another gas windfall.
nce429fb4a0.why: Australia is a major liquefied natural gas exporter, so global gas prices directly affect its export revenues and government income.

n60f5f41b61.headline: West Asia conflict raises cost pressures for Indian firms: Crisil
n60f5f41b61.summary: Crisil warned that if the war on Iran and its counterattacks persist or escalate, Indian firms could face adverse cost pressures from resulting uncertainties.
n60f5f41b61.why: Crisil is an Indian credit rating and research agency, and its sector assessments inform investors on corporate credit risk.

n9d2185ba79.headline: UK firms pull fixed energy deals as Iran war pushes up prices
n9d2185ba79.summary: The number of fixed-term energy deals in the UK has more than halved as wholesale energy prices surge. The data points to businesses and households losing price protection.
n9d2185ba79.why: Fixed-term energy contracts shield buyers from wholesale price swings, so their withdrawal signals stress in the energy market.

n4d84a3bdd1.headline: Aviva flags potential for Iran conflict to send claims costs rising
n4d84a3bdd1.summary: Aviva chief executive Amanda Blanc said supply chains could suffer if the conflict is prolonged. The warning points to rising claims costs for the insurer.
n4d84a3bdd1.why: Aviva is a major UK insurer, and claims costs drive its underwriting profitability.

n7ee458b191.headline: Iran launches new wave of attacks on Israeli  and US bases while Israel begins new strikes in Lebanon
n7ee458b191.summary: Iran launched a new wave of attacks on Israeli and American bases after threatening military and economic infrastructure across the region. Israel began new strikes in Lebanon.
n7ee458b191.why: Attacks on energy and infrastructure across the Gulf region can disrupt oil supply and raise risk premiums in global markets.
n7ee458b191.why_moved: The escalation of attacks between Iran, Israel and the US, with threats to regional infrastructure, raises fears of supply disruption in oil markets.

n3b6ca9b33e.headline: China sets a lower economic growth target of 4.5% to 5% for 2026 as challenges loom
n3b6ca9b33e.summary: China has set a slightly lower economic growth target of 4.5% to 5% for 2026, amid a property slump, other domestic headwinds and uncertainty abroad.
n3b6ca9b33e.why: China's growth target signals the government's economic priorities and influences expectations for global demand, commodities and Asian equities.

n16dbb08a28.headline: Rupee Recovers From Record Low, Settles 45 Paise Higher At 91.60 Against US Dollar
n16dbb08a28.summary: The rupee closed 45 paise higher at 91.60 against the dollar after rebounding from a record low. Strong domestic equities and possible RBI intervention supported it.
n16dbb08a28.why: The rupee's level affects import costs and inflation in India, and the Reserve Bank of India manages its volatility.
n16dbb08a28.why_moved: Strong domestic equities and possible RBI intervention supported the rupee, while a strong dollar, higher crude prices and foreign fund outflows weighed on it.

nc3e588eb45.headline: Drone Strike Hits Bahrain Refinery as Crack Spreads Surge
nc3e588eb45.summary: A drone strike hit oil infrastructure in Bahrain's Ma'ameer industrial area, according to early reports. Refining margins surged, raising concerns about Gulf refining assets.
nc3e588eb45.why: Refining crack spreads measure the margin between crude and refined products; surges signal tight product supply and strong refiner profitability.
nc3e588eb45.why_moved: A strike on a Gulf refinery raises concerns about supply vulnerability, and refining crack spreads are surging.

ned08113489.headline: Wavering households ease urgency for more rate hikes
ned08113489.summary: Economic data released this week leaves the Reserve Bank of Australia less concerned about underlying momentum. The data reduces urgency for more rate hikes.
ned08113489.why: The Reserve Bank of Australia sets the country's cash rate, which drives borrowing costs, the Australian dollar and asset valuations.

n2c6dfec3ca.headline: South Korean company to build synthetic graphite anode material plant in Thai Nguyen
n2c6dfec3ca.summary: South Korean battery materials company Posco Future M will develop a new synthetic graphite anode material plant in Thai Nguyen, Vietnam.
n2c6dfec3ca.why: Posco Future M supplies battery materials, and graphite anodes are a key component in lithium-ion batteries for electric vehicles.

n625bd8cb99.headline: Cove Capital, AHQ sign MoU for critical minerals projects
n625bd8cb99.summary: US-based Cove Capital signed a memorandum of understanding with Saudi Arabia's AHQ to advance cooperation on critical minerals projects between the two countries.
n625bd8cb99.why: Critical minerals underpin batteries and other strategic supply chains, so cross-border project partnerships matter for mining investors.

n5c1e7d8491.headline: Seoul’s market ambitions meet a hard sell-off, as profit-taking hits the KOSPI
n5c1e7d8491.summary: Foreign investors kept selling into a volatile KOSPI, following a record monthly net outflow. Another heavy daily sell-off added fresh downward pressure on the index.
n5c1e7d8491.why: The KOSPI is South Korea's main stock index, heavily weighted toward large chipmakers and industrial groups. Foreign flows strongly influence its direction.

impacts.name: KOSPI
impacts.why: Heavy foreign selling and a daily sell-off added downward pressure on the index.

n5c1e7d8491.why_moved: Foreign investors kept selling after a record monthly net outflow, and another heavy daily selloff added pressure on the index.

n97a37028c4.headline: Banks ramp up capital plans ahead of AGM season
n97a37028c4.summary: Many Vietnamese banks are planning significant charter capital increases during the 2026 annual general meeting season. The moves would raise their registered capital.
n97a37028c4.why: Charter capital increases strengthen banks' capital bases, supporting lending growth and regulatory capital ratios. They often dilute existing shareholders through new share issues.

n72f3c7bb42.headline: Rupee Holds on to Huge Win Streak Against US Dollar Despite Other Losses
n72f3c7bb42.summary: The Pakistani rupee closed higher against the US dollar for a 113th consecutive day on Thursday and gained against some other currencies.
n72f3c7bb42.why: The rupee's exchange rate affects import costs, inflation and external financing for Pakistan, making it a key macro indicator for investors.

impacts.name: Pakistani rupee
impacts.why: The rupee closed higher against the US dollar for a 113th consecutive session.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n532232d735.headline: How the Gulf Countries Are Responding to Iran’s Attacks
n532232d735.summary: Abu Dhabi, Doha and Riyadh are weighing their options in response to Iran's attacks, according to Foreign Policy.
n532232d735.why: Abu Dhabi, Doha and Riyadh are major oil and gas producers and investment sources, so their security posture influences energy supply and regional capital flows.

n49f1e8e999.headline: Asian LNG Prices Fall on U.S. Plan to Secure Hormuz Strait
n49f1e8e999.summary: Asian spot LNG prices fell from a three-year high after the U.S. pledged political risk insurance and guarantees for tankers transiting Hormuz. Qatar has halted LNG production, and the strait remains effectively closed.
n49f1e8e999.why: Liquefied natural gas is traded by tanker, and the Strait of Hormuz is a key route for Qatari LNG and Gulf oil. Shipping disruptions there move global gas and energy prices.
n49f1e8e999.why_moved: The U.S. pledge of political risk insurance and guarantees for Hormuz tankers eased supply concerns from a three-year high. Qatar's LNG halt keeps the strait's disruption in focus.

n8e1025060c.headline: Iran fires more missiles, drones across Gulf region as war shows no letup
n8e1025060c.summary: Gulf countries face a continued barrage of Iranian missile and drone attacks. The U.S. and Israel have pledged to continue their military assault on Iran.
n8e1025060c.why: The Gulf holds a large share of global oil and gas production and export capacity. Attacks on the region raise supply risk and insurance costs for energy shipments.

nab0549d889.headline: A landslide election victory is only the first test for Bangladesh’s BNP
nab0549d889.summary: The Bangladesh Nationalist Party won a landslide in the February 2026 election. Considerable challenges lie ahead for the new government.
nab0549d889.why: Political stability and policy direction in Bangladesh affect its garment exports, foreign investment and economic reforms. Election outcomes influence investor confidence in the country.

na4c1011b84.headline: Property ID cards expected to redefine Vietnam’s real estate market
na4c1011b84.summary: Assigning each property a unique identification code and publishing transaction data on a state-managed system is expected to fundamentally change Vietnam's real estate market.
na4c1011b84.why: Greater transparency in property transactions affects valuations, financing and compliance for developers and lenders.

n3fd26cb482.headline: Fuel supplies to be boosted as 16 Tankers dock, en route and await loading at Myanmar port
n3fd26cb482.summary: Myanmar's Ministry of Energy says two fuel tankers are docked at Thilawa Port, six are en route and eight more are waiting to load.
n3fd26cb482.why: Fuel import flows through ports determine domestic fuel availability and transport costs in the economy.

nd4e8ade9ee.headline: China to build
nd4e8ade9ee.summary: China plans to build a childbirth-friendly society within five years. Measures include expanded childcare subsidies, covered pregnancy and IVF costs, housing support for families and a silver economy for seniors.
nd4e8ade9ee.why: Demographic policy affects China's labour supply, household spending and long-term growth, which matters to global investors.

n1a2246ac08.headline: South Korea activates US$68bil market stability fund over Mideast crisis
n1a2246ac08.summary: South Korea has activated a US$68 billion market stability fund. The fund includes money earmarked for bond and stock markets as well as real estate financing.
n1a2246ac08.why: Market stability funds are state backstops that aim to support domestic asset prices and liquidity during periods of stress.
n1a2246ac08.why_moved: The fund is a government response to market stress linked to the Middle East crisis, and it targets bond, equity and property markets directly.

n174866fb9f.headline: President Trump, Pam Bondi sued over sale of TikTok assets
n174866fb9f.summary: A lawsuit accuses the Trump administration of ignoring legislation aimed at stopping Chinese propaganda and helping broker a partial TikTok asset sale to businessmen close to Trump.
n174866fb9f.why: TikTok's US operations are subject to national security rules, and the outcome of ownership disputes affects its valuation and business.

nd73c71bce1.headline: China sets 2026 growth target at 4.5%–5%, below 2025 pace
nd73c71bce1.summary: China set its 2026 growth target at 4.5% to 5% and unveiled its 15th five-year plan, pledging investment in innovation, high-tech industries and higher household consumption.
nd73c71bce1.why: China's growth target guides fiscal and monetary policy and influences global demand for commodities and goods.
nd73c71bce1.why_moved: A lower growth target signals slower expansion than in 2025, which matters for global demand expectations.

n3b4bd47576.headline: China to inject US$44bil into state banks
n3b4bd47576.summary: China plans to inject US$44 billion into state banks, according to the annual government work report presented at the opening of the National People's Congress.
n3b4bd47576.why: Capital injections strengthen bank balance sheets and support lending, affecting China's financial system.

n92bad765b8.headline: Strait of Hormuz closure threatens 40,000 t/month copper cathode flows to Gulf as Jebel Ali blocked, Khor Fakkan and Fujairah near capacity Strait of Hormuz closure threatens copper cathode flows
n92bad765b8.summary: The Strait of Hormuz closure threatens about 40,000 tonnes a month of copper cathode flows to the Gulf, with Jebel Ali blocked and Khor Fakkan and Fujairah near capacity.
n92bad765b8.why: Copper cathodes are refined copper used in wiring and industrial production, and Gulf ports are key transit hubs for metals trade.

impacts.name: Copper
impacts.why: Blocked Gulf port flows could disrupt copper cathode supply and logistics.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n449c93f306.headline: Will continue to support swift end of conflicts in Ukraine, West Asia: PM Modi  after talks with Finland's President
n449c93f306.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi urged for a swift resolution to conflicts in Ukraine and West Asia, emphasizing that no issue can be resolved through prolonged conflict.
n449c93f306.why: Political stability in these regions is crucial for global economic stability, energy markets, and international trade.
